pages.text: These artifacts are in the Geb Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Geb to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
A hammer that can stun an enemy. Use charged melee attacks to make the most of its control.
A shovel that reduces exhaustion when digging and can drop a little experience from broken blocks.
A pickaxe for mining and chopping. Fully charged attacks with it are especially effective against stone constructs.
